subject: Radiology
question: A radiology technician accidentally receives ionizing radiation during an equipment malfunction. The severity of biological damage caused by the radiation depends on several factors. Which of the following is the most important determinant of the extent of radiation-induced tissue damage?

options.D: Blood group of the exposed individual

subject: Radiology
question: The extent of tissue damage produced by ionizing radiation depends primarily on which factor?
explanation: Radiation injury is mainly dose dependent. Higher doses produce greater DNA damage and cell death. Radiosensitive tissues are affected earliest.
